title: Recurring charge plan created
description: Event generated when a recurring charge plan is created

created_at.description: Plan creation date and time in ISO-8601 format

examples: Description of the recurring charge plan.

number_of_cycles.description: Number of cycles in the recurring charge plan

processing_code.description: Character sequence representing a group of transactions

first_cycles_to_skip.description: Number of initial cycles to skip

discount_percentage.description: Discount percentage that applies to the charge

examples: Secondary description for the recurring charge plan

secondary_processing_code.description: Character sequence representing a group of transactions

minimum_sepend_to_charge.description: Minimum value to charge the client

cid.title: Correlational ID of event
cid.description: Correlational ID of event. This is not a unique value. Different events (possibly from the same domain + event_type) can share the same the cid. This is useful to identify all events produced from the same request or process.
